score_objections.objection: Every AI-specific source points the same way: praises China's push of AI into classrooms, calls AI inevitable, urges faster defensive use of AI, and on cyber rules warns a 300-page regulation would overwhelm operators while calling for balance with innovation. There is no source where he calls for AI guardrails or restrictions. A 0 'Mixed' implies offsetting pro-regulation evidence that does not appear in these sources; 1 'Light touch' fits the record better. Evidence is thin overall, so 0 is defensible only as an abstention.
